name: figure-forge
description: Builds Nature-style scientific figures — box plots, forest plots, flowcharts, diagrams and multi-panel composites — at 600 dpi with editable-text labels, then runs a self-correcting quality loop that guarantees no label sits outside its box or covers a curve, marker or arrow. Exports editable-text SVG plus 600 dpi PNG/TIFF, PDF and PPTX, and writes a QC audit and a visual proof overlay for every figure. `/figure-forge:advise` recommends how to visualise before you plot.
